newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain 90-day t-bill rate rises to 5.51 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain 90-day t-bill rate rises to 5.51 pct.

text.p: The average yield at this week's tender for ten million dinars of 90-day Bahrain treasury bills rose to 5.51 percent from 5.49 last week when the bills were for 91 days, a Bahrain Monetary Agency spokesman said.
The average price was 98.640 and the minimum price accepted was 98.636.
Banks submitted bids for 23 million dinars worth of bills, down from 28.2 million dinars the previous week.
The bills are offered on Monday and issued on Wednesday.
